# @onsvisual/svelte-components

> Svelte 5 components that render ONS Design System markup and styles, for ONS web pages, articles and data visualisations. Version 2.3.0.

- Storybook docs, with examples of every component: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/
- Workbench, to try out components and their props: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/workbench/
- Full reference, with every component's props and an example: `node_modules/@onsvisual/svelte-components/dist/llms-full.txt` (or https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/llms-full.txt)
- Each component's docs and types are in the package: `node_modules/@onsvisual/svelte-components/dist/components/<Folder>/docs/component.md` and `node_modules/@onsvisual/svelte-components/dist/components/<Folder>/<Name>.svelte.d.ts`

## Setup

- Install: `npm install @onsvisual/svelte-components`. Version 2 needs Svelte 5. (Svelte 3/4 projects use version 1: `npm install @onsvisual/svelte-components@v1-legacy`.)
- Import the CSS once, eg. in the root `+layout.svelte`: `import "@onsvisual/svelte-components/css/main.css";`
- Import components by name: `import { Header, Section, Footer } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";`
- Peer dependencies, needed by some components: `@popperjs/core`, `accessible-autocomplete`, `d3-scale`, `d3-shape`, `parse-color`, `pym.js`, `tick-manager`, `viewport-details`.

## Rules for using the components

- Write Svelte 5 (runes) code: `$state`, `$derived`, `$props`, snippets and `onclick`-style attributes, not `export let`, `$:`, `<slot>` or `on:click`.
- Events: use the callback props, eg. `<Button onClick={...}>` or `<Input onChange={({ value }) => ...}>`. Each callback gets the same value as the matching dispatched event's `detail`. The dispatched events (`on:click` etc.) still work, but are only for Svelte 4-style code.
- Named slots are now snippet props, eg. `{#snippet titleContent()}...{/snippet}` inside a Card, or Scroller's `background` and `foreground`. Content passed with `slot="..."` is silently not rendered. Child content is the `children` snippet, as normal.
- Bindings: use `bind:` with a `$state` variable, eg. `let value = $state(null);` and `<Input bind:value />`. If the variable starts `undefined`, the component sets it to the prop's default (version 2.3.0 and later; earlier 2.x versions throw `props_invalid_value` for some props, so start bound variables with a value there).
- Layout: `Section` already renders a `Container` (narrow width, with a bottom margin), so don't put a `Container` inside a `Section`. Use one or the other, and set `width` and the margins on it.
- Extra CSS classes: most components take a `cls` prop (Toolbar components use `classes`).
- Some props render trusted HTML with `{@html}`, with no sanitising: List items, DescriptionList values, Table cells, DataCard captions and Theme head styles. Never pass user input to them.
- Form components (Input, Dropdown, Select, Radios, Checkboxes, Textarea) need a `label` for accessibility, and an `id` if the label is hidden.
- Check a component's props in its `.d.ts` file or in the full reference before using it. Don't guess prop names.

## ONS Design System CSS

The package CSS includes version 73.5.0 of the ONS Design System CSS, so any `ons-*` class from that version can be used directly in markup, eg. the grid (`ons-grid`, `ons-grid__col`, `ons-col-6@m`), utility classes such as `ons-u-mb-l` (bottom margin) or `ons-u-fs-r--b` (bold text), and Design System components that this package doesn't wrap. See https://service-manual.ons.gov.uk/design-system (it documents the latest version, which may be newer than 73.5.0). Prefer the components in this package where one exists.

## Components

### Wrappers

- [Container](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-container--docs): A container to set the width and minimum height of a block of content.
- [Embed](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-embed--docs): A container for content designed to appear within an `<iframe>`. The component does two things: 1. Overrides padding, so that content can fill the full width of its iframe. 2. Initialises a Pym.js child for the iframe, so that it can communicate its height with its parent page.
- [EmbedParent](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-embedparent--docs): Add responsive Pym.js iframes to a page. The child page `href` can be a relative or absolute path, or a full URL. When referencing another page within the same app, be sure to use SvelteKit's `resolve()` function to ensure that the path is correct wherever your app is deployed.
- [LazyLoad](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-lazyload--docs): A wrapper component that uses IntersectionObserver to allow the Svelte components or HTML elements it contains to be lazy loaded, ie. to be added to the page (or DOM) only when they enter the viewport.
- [Main](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-main--docs): This component creates a styled `<main>` element to wrap the primary contents of a page (generally everything between the page header and footer).
- [Observe](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-observe--docs): A wrapper component that uses IntersectionObserver to monitor whether the elements in contains are within the current viewport.
- [Theme](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-theme--docs): A component that sets the colour scheme of its child components using CSS variables.
- [WidthReset](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-widthreset--docs): A simple wrapper component that can be used within a column on a page to break out to the full page width. Can be used, for example, to create a full-width scrollytelling section within an article on the ONS website.

### Navigation

- [BackLink](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/navigation-backlink--docs): Link that can be used to return to the top of a page, or to a table of contents.
- [Breadcrumb](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/navigation-breadcrumb--docs): Displays a breadcrumb with the current page's parents.
- [Contents](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/navigation-contents--docs): Displays a table of contents based on an array of links. Can be used for in-page navigation, or for navigation between sibling pages.
- [Paginator](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/navigation-paginator--docs): A very simple next/previous page paginator.
- [RelatedContent](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/navigation-relatedcontent--docs): Dispay related content for a page.
- [SkipLink](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/navigation-skiplink--docs): An invisible link to skip from the top of the page header to the content of the page. Should be the first focusable item on the page, and is included by default in the [Header](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-header--docs) component

### Form elements

- [Button](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-button--docs): A button/link component that can be styled in various ways. It will render as an `<a>` link if it has an `href` property defined.
- [Checkbox](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-checkbox--docs): A checkbox element with various styling and labelling options. Its "checked" attribute can be bound to a Svelte boolean (true/false) variable.
- [Checkboxes](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-checkboxes--docs): A component for defining a group of checkbox elements, whose checked values can be bound to Svelte variables, or grouped in an array.
- [Dropdown](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-dropdown--docs): A standard `<select>` component with Svelte bindings and events.
- [ErrorPanel](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-errorpanel--docs): Use this component to show validation errors by wrapping form inputs and fieldsets.
- [ErrorSummary](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-errorsummary--docs): A panel to summarise errors on a form/input. The errors can be defined in an `items` array, or as plain text/html within the component.
- [Input](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-input--docs): A standard `<input>` element with Svelte bindings and events.
- [Radio](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-radios--docs): used with `Radios`; see its docs.
- [Radios](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-radios--docs): A component for defining a group of radio inputs, where the selected item id can be bound to a Svelte variable.
- [Select](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-select--docs): (also exported as `AccessibleSelect`) An extended alternative to an HTML `<select>` component (see Dropdown), with auto-complete and the ability to have a custom **loadOptions** function.
- [Textarea](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-textarea--docs): A standard `<textarea>` element with Svelte bindings and events.
- [HelpModal](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-toolbar--docs): used with `Toolbar`; see its docs. Experimental.
- [ToolbarIcon](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-toolbar--docs): used with `Toolbar`; see its docs. Experimental.
- [Toolbar](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-toolbar--docs): A toolbar component. Use `ToolbarsContainer` even if using one toolbar as it contains a store for all the IDs and the activeID. Experimental.
- [ToolbarButton](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-toolbar--docs): used with `Toolbar`; see its docs. Experimental.
- [ToolbarDivider](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-toolbar--docs): used with `Toolbar`; see its docs. Experimental.
- [ToolbarsContainer](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-toolbar--docs): used with `Toolbar`; see its docs. Experimental.
- [ToolControl](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-toolbar--docs): used with `Toolbar`; see its docs. Experimental.
- [ToolControls](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-toolbar--docs): used with `Toolbar`; see its docs. Experimental.
- [ButtonGroup](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-buttongroup--docs): Radio inputs dressed up as a button group. Experimental.
- [ButtonGroupItem](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-buttongroup--docs): used with `ButtonGroup`; see its docs. Experimental.

### Layout

- [Accordion](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-accordion--docs): An accordion component.
- [AccordionItem](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-accordion--docs): used with `Accordion`; see its docs.
- [Card](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-card--docs): Display content and links as cards. Can be used in combination with the `<Grid>` component to combine multiple cards.
- [Details](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-details--docs): (also exported as `Twisty`) An expandable `<details>` ("twisty") component, which can be open or closed by default.
- [Divider](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-divider--docs): A component to draw a divider between blocks of contnet.
- [Footer](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-footer--docs): A footer component with compact mode and theming options.
- [Grid](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-grid--docs): (also exported as `Cards`) A media grid component, useful for images and small multiple charts. Setting `colwidth` to **full** allows for a single cell/image/chart with an optional caption.
- [GridCell](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-grid--docs): used with `Grid`; see its docs.
- [Header](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-header--docs): A header component with compact mode and theming options.
- [Hero](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-hero--docs): (also exported as `Titleblock`) A hero/title block suitable for a standard pages, with optional metadata block.
- [Highlight](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-highlight--docs): A large text block that can be used as a standfirst or transition between sections of a feature article, with various options and style customisations.
- [List](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-list--docs): A list component with modes for numbered, bulleted, dashed and bare lists. There is also an option to define list items as an array.
- [Li](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-list--docs): used with `List`; see its docs.
- [NavSection](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-navsections--docs): used with `NavSections`; see its docs.
- [NavSections](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-navsections--docs): Use this component to allow users to quickly jump to named sections within a long page of content.
- [PhaseBanner](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-phasebanner--docs): Display a phase banner on prototypes, alpha and beta products.
- [Scroller](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-scroller--docs): Components for adding interactive scrollytelling sections to a feature article.
- [ScrollerSection](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-scroller--docs): used with `Scroller`; see its docs.
- [Section](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-section--docs): A layout block for text content, including an optional title.
- [Tabs](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-tabs--docs): Use tabs to help users navigate between short sections of related content within a single page, showing one section at a time.
- [Tab](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-tabs--docs): used with `Tabs`; see its docs.

### Information and media

- [AnalyticsBanner](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-analyticsbanner--docs): This component will display a cookie banner and export a function that allows you to push events to the Google Analytics dataLayer array.
- [analyticsEvent](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-analyticsbanner--docs): function exported alongside AnalyticsBanner.
- [AnnouncementBanner](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-announcementbanner--docs): This banner is used to highlight important messages for all users of a service or website. The banner is only meant for critical short-term messages, and should be placed immediately below the website navigation header (and above the breadcrumb).
- [Blockquote](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-blockquote--docs): A component to highlight a pull quote on a page, with optional attribution.
- [DescriptionList](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-descriptionlist--docs): A component to display metadata in a tabular format.
- [DocumentList](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-documentlist--docs): A component for defining a list of pages or links. Items can either be defined in an array of objects or as individual `<Document>` components.
- [Document](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-documentlist--docs): used with `DocumentList`; see its docs.
- [ErrorPage](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-errorpage--docs): An error page component that will display generic error messages for "page not found" (404) or other errors.
- [Image](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-image--docs): Insert an image with an optional caption.
- [Notice](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-notice--docs): Container for displaying notices on a page.
- [ShareButtons](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-sharebuttons--docs): Add social sharing buttons to a page.
- [Summary](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-summary--docs): A summary table for selected variables etc.
- [Timeline](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-timeline--docs): A component to display a linear record of past and future events.
- [TimelineItem](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-timeline--docs): used with `Timeline`; see its docs.

### Data visualisation

- [UpdateStatus](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/data-visualisation-updatestatus--docs): Shows a short status message for recently updated content, or falls back to a standard "Last updated" label.
- [ChangeStat](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/data-visualisation-changestat--docs): Shows a short directional stat such as `7% lower`, `1.3pp higher`, or `69 (0.7%) fewer`.
- [DataCard](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/data-visualisation-datacard--docs): A component for presenting key facts and figures as a grid of "cards". Experimental.
- [Table](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/data-visualisation-table--docs): A table component with various customisation options.

### Decorators

- [Em](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/decorators-em--docs): A component to visually highlight text. Can be used for inline text or to provide a "badge".
- [Icon](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/decorators-icon--docs): Make use of pre-defined icons in your projects. The icon fill is set to `currentColor`, so will render in the same colour as the surrounding text.
- [Indent](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/decorators-indent--docs): An indented block of text.
- [Tooltip](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/decorators-tooltip--docs): A component that displays a tooltip when the element it is wrapped around is hovered over or focused on.

## Charts and maps (separate packages)

These packages are developed separately, have fewer options, and may change more than this one. Check their docs and types before using them.

- `@onsvisual/svelte-charts` (version 0.4.11 when this file was generated): `Chart`, `LineChart`, `BarChart`, `ColumnChart`, `ScatterChart`, `DotPlotChart`. Their docs and examples are also on the Storybook site under "Data visualisation", and in `node_modules/@onsvisual/svelte-components/dist/components/<ChartName>/docs/`. They're written in Svelte 4 style, so use `on:` events with them. In a Vite/SvelteKit app, add `@onsvisual/svelte-charts` and `layercake` to `ssr.noExternal`.
- `@onsvisual/svelte-maps`: MapLibre maps (`Map`, `MapSource`, `MapLayer`, `MapTooltip`). Its components still dispatch Svelte 4-style events, so use `on:` and `bind:` with them.

## Component reference

### Container

A container to set the width and minimum height of a block of content.

`import { Container } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-container--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `id` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set the unique ID of the container
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the container
- `width` (`"narrow" | "medium" | "wide" | "wider" | "full"`, default `"wide"`): Sets the width of the container
- `height` (`number | string | null`, default `null`): Sets the height of the container
- `marginTop` (`boolean`, default `false`): Adds margin above container
- `marginBottom` (`boolean`, default `false`): Adds margin below container
- `theme` (`"light" | "dark" | "paleblue" | "blue" | "navyblue" | "grey" | null`, default `null`): Optional: Sets a base theme ("light", "dark" or null for no theme)
- `themeOverrides` (`Record<string, string>`, default `{}`): Optional: Define additional props to override the base theme
- `background` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Overrides the base theme background (accepts any valid CSS background value)

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Container } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Container width={narrow|medium|wide|wider|full} theme="light">{child_components}</Container>
```

### Embed

A container for content designed to appear within an `<iframe>`. The component does two things: 1. Overrides padding, so that content can fill the full width of its iframe. 2. Initialises a Pym.js child for the iframe, so that it can communicate its height with its parent page.

`import { Embed } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-embed--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `id` (`string | null`, default `null`): (Optional) ID for embed
- `pymChild` (`PymChild | null`, default `null`, bindable): Binding for pymChild element (can be used to send messages to parent of iframe)
- `polling` (`number | false`, default `500`): Frequency (in milliseconds) of iframe height updates. Set as "false" to disable polling.
- `onLoad` (`(detail: LoadDetail) => void`): Callback for the `load` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Embed } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Embed>
  {child_components}
</Embed>
```

### EmbedParent

Add responsive Pym.js iframes to a page. The child page `href` can be a relative or absolute path, or a full URL. When referencing another page within the same app, be sure to use SvelteKit's `resolve()` function to ensure that the path is correct wherever your app is deployed.

`import { EmbedParent } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-embedparent--docs

Props:

- `id` (`string`, default `uid`): ID of the container element (the iframe gets `${id}-iframe`). Generated by default
- `href` (`string`, required): URL of the child page to embed in the iframe
- `title` (`string | null`, default `null`): Accessible name for the iframe
- `name` (`string | null`, default `null`): Name attribute for the iframe (defaults to a slug of `title`)
- `pymParent` (`PymParent | null`, default `null`, bindable): Binding for the pym.js Parent instance (eg. to send messages to the child page)
- `onLoad` (`(detail: LoadDetail) => void`): Callback for the `load` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { EmbedParent } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<EmbedParent href="child_page_url" id="iframe" title="Accessible name" />
```

### LazyLoad

A wrapper component that uses IntersectionObserver to allow the Svelte components or HTML elements it contains to be lazy loaded, ie. to be added to the page (or DOM) only when they enter the viewport.

`import { LazyLoad } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-lazyload--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `entered` (`boolean`, default `false`, bindable): Bind to this variable to monitor whether the component has entered the viewport (boolean true/false).
- `initialHeight` (`number`, default `400`): Set the initial "placeholder" height of the component in pixels.
- `rootMargin` (`number`, default `200`): Set how many pixels from the viewport you want lazy loading to kick in.

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { LazyLoad } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

{#each Array.from(Array(20).keys()) as i}
  <LazyLoad>
    <div class="img-container">
      <img src="https://picsum.photos/400/300?random={i}" alt="" />
    </div>
  </LazyLoad>
{/each}

<style>
  .img-container {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    height: 400px;
    background: #eee;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
</style>
```

### Main

This component creates a styled `<main>` element to wrap the primary contents of a page (generally everything between the page header and footer).

`import { Main } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-main--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `id` (`string`, default `"main"`): Sets the unique ID that can be targetted by hyperlinks

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Main } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<!-- Header goes here -->
<Main>
  {child_components}
</Main>
<!-- Footer goes here -->
```

### Observe

A wrapper component that uses IntersectionObserver to monitor whether the elements in contains are within the current viewport.

`import { Observe } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-observe--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `visible` (`boolean`, default `false`, bindable): Bind to this variable to monitor visiblity (boolean true/false).
- `rootMargin` (`number`, default `0`): Number of pixels before/after the viewport that component is considered "visible" (default = 0).
- `onEnter` (`(entry: IntersectionObserverEntry) => void`): Callback for the `enter` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`
- `onExit` (`(entry: IntersectionObserverEntry) => void`): Callback for the `exit` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Observe } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  let visible = $state(false);

  const colors = ["yellow", "green", "blue", "purple", "red", "orange"];
</script>

{#each colors as color}
<Observe
  bind:visible
  onEnter={() => console.log(`${color} entered`)}
  onExit={() => console.log(`${color} exited`)}>
  <div class="section" style:background={color} style:height="400px"></div>
</Observe>
{/each}
```

### Theme

A component that sets the colour scheme of its child components using CSS variables.

`import { Theme } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-theme--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `theme` (`ThemeName`, default `null`): Sets a base theme ("light", "dark" or null for no theme)
- `overrides` (`Record<string, string>`, default `{}`): Define additional props to override the base theme
- `background` (`string | null`, default `null`): Overrides the base theme background (accepts any valid CSS background value)
- `global` (`boolean`, default `false`): Sets the theme at html body level (only use this at the top level)
- `allowClientOverrides` (`boolean`, default `false`): Allows client imported CSS for embeddable content
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the theme container

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Theme } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Theme theme={light|dark|paleblue|blue|navyblue|grey}> {child_components} </Theme>
```

### WidthReset

A simple wrapper component that can be used within a column on a page to break out to the full page width. Can be used, for example, to create a full-width scrollytelling section within an article on the ONS website.

`import { WidthReset } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/wrappers-widthreset--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `mode` (`"default"|"legacy"`, default `"default"`): How the full width is worked out. "default" works in any column that is centred on the page. "legacy" targets the article column of the older ONS website template (`#main > .wrapper > .col-wrap`)
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the wrapper

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { WidthReset } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<WidthReset mode="legacy">
  {child_components}
</WidthReset>
```

### BackLink

Link that can be used to return to the top of a page, or to a table of contents.

`import { BackLink } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/navigation-backlink--docs

Props:

- `href` (`string`, default `"#top"`): Href for top of page or contents section
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Add a CSS class to the link

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { BackLink } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<BackLink href="#top" />
```

### Breadcrumb

Displays a breadcrumb with the current page's parents.

`import { Breadcrumb } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/navigation-breadcrumb--docs

Props:

- `links` (`{ label: string; href?: string }[]`, default `[]`): An array of links in the format {label, href}
- `backHref` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Link href if component is used for a single back-link
- `width` (`"narrow"|"medium"|"wide"|"wider"|"full"`, default `"wide"`): Sets the width of the container
- `cls` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `theme` (`"light"|"dark"|"paleblue"|"blue"|"navyblue"|"grey"|null`, default `null`): Optional: Sets a base theme ("light", "dark", null etc)
- `themeOverrides` (`Record<string, string>`, default `{}`): Optional: Define additional props to override the base theme
- `background` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Overrides the base theme background (accepts any valid CSS background value)

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Breadcrumb } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Breadcrumb links={[
  {label: 'Home', href: '/'},
  {label: 'Parent page', href: '/parent'}
]} />
```

### Contents

Displays a table of contents based on an array of links. Can be used for in-page navigation, or for navigation between sibling pages.

`import { Contents } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/navigation-contents--docs

Props:

- `title` (`string`, default `"Contents"`): Sets the title of the contents block
- `hideTitle` (`boolean`, default `false`): Visually hides the title of the block
- `links` (`{ label: string; href?: string }[]`, default `[]`): An array of links for the contentents block in the form {label, href?}. Excluding href renders an item as plain text and marks it as the current section for screenreaders.
- `skipHref` (`string|null`, default `null`): An anchor link URL to the main content of the page (to skip contents)
- `cls` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Contents } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Contents links={[
  { label: 'Overview' },
  { label: 'Who should take part and why', href: '#0' },
  { label: 'How your information is used', href: '#0' },
  { label: 'The 2019 Census Rehearsal', href: '#0' },
  { label: 'Online census', href: '#0' },
]} />
```

### Paginator

A very simple next/previous page paginator.

`import { Paginator } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/navigation-paginator--docs

Props:

- `pageCount` (`number`, default `1`): Total number of pages
- `pageCurrent` (`number`, default `1`): Number of the current page
- `nextHref` (`string | null`, default `null`): URL of next page (use null if on last page)
- `prevHref` (`string | null`, default `null`): URL of previous page (use null if on first page)
- `nextTitle` (`string | null`, default `null`): (Optional) title of next page (with no label, will default to 'page {x-1} of {n}')
- `prevTitle` (`string | null`, default `null`): (Optional) title of previous page (with no label, will default to 'page {x+1} of {n}')

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Paginator } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Paginator
  pageCount={10}
  pageCurrent={2}
  nextHref="#3"
  prevHref="#1"
/>
```

### RelatedContent

`import { RelatedContent } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/navigation-relatedcontent--docs

Props:

- `title` (`string`, default `"Related content"`): Title for the section
- `links` (`{ title: string; href: string }[] | object`, default `[]`): Links in the form {title, href}
- `related` (`{ title?: string; links: { title: string; href: string }[] | object }[]`): Define multiple links sections in the form {title, links: [{title, href}]} (overrides above options)
- `cls` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `children` (`import('svelte').Snippet`): Child content

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { RelatedContent } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<RelatedContent
  links={[
    { title: "How we will contact or visit you", href: "#0" },
    { title: "Media enquiries", href: "#0" }
  ]}/>
```

### SkipLink

An invisible link to skip from the top of the page header to the content of the page. Should be the first focusable item on the page, and is included by default in the [Header](https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-header--docs) component

`import { SkipLink } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/navigation-skiplink--docs

Props:

- `href` (`string`, default `"#main"`): Anchor link to <main> page element

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { SkipLink } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<SkipLink/>
<!-- page body -->
```

### Button

A button/link component that can be styled in various ways. It will render as an `<a>` link if it has an `href` property defined.

`import { Button } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-button--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `iconSlot` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Custom icon content, used instead of the `icon` prop
- `type` (`"button" | "submit" | "reset"`, default `"button"`): Type of button
- `variant` (`"primary" | "secondary" | "ghost"`, default `"primary"`): Style variant of button
- `href` (`string | null`, default `null`): Href of button (renders button as a link)
- `download` (`string | null`, default `null`): File name if link is used for a file download (only if href is also specified)
- `rel` (`string | null`, default `null`): HTML "rel" attribute for hyperlinks (Eg. rel="nofollow")
- `noScroll` (`boolean`, default `false`): Don't scroll when link is followed (only if href is also specified)
- `small` (`boolean`, default `false`): Make button smaller
- `icon` (`"arrow" | "carret" | "chevron" | "code" | "cog" | "copy" | "cross" | "delete" | "download" | "edit" | "edit-text" | "expand" | "external" | "minus" | "pin" | "plus" | "print" | "save" | "saveas" | "search" | "shrink" | "signout" | "tick" | "upload" | null`, default `null`): Icon on button, eg. "arrow", "search"
- `iconPosition` (`"before" | "after"`, default `"before"`): Position of icon
- `iconRotation` (`number`, default `0`): Rotation of icon in degrees (clockwise)
- `disabled` (`boolean`, default `false`): Show button as disabled
- `hideLabel` (`boolean`, default `false`): Visually hide the button text (for icon-only buttons)
- `arialabel` (`string | null`, default `null`): Aria label for button
- `color` (`string | null`, default `null`): Set a colour for the button
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `onClick` (`(event: MouseEvent) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `click` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  // Define your own function on click
  const handleClick = (event) => console.log(event);
</script>

<!-- Standard button with an onClick callback -->
<Button onClick={handleClick}>Button text</Button>

<!-- Button-styled link with href -->
<Button href="#">Link text</Button>
```

### Checkbox

A checkbox element with various styling and labelling options. Its "checked" attribute can be bound to a Svelte boolean (true/false) variable.

`import { Checkbox } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-checkbox--docs

Props:

- `id` (`string`, default `""`): ID for input element
- `label` (`string`, default `""`): Label for input
- `description` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Extended description for element
- `checked` (`boolean`, default `item.checked ?? false`, bindable): Binding for checked state of input
- `disabled` (`boolean`, default `false`): Option to disable input
- `item` (`CheckboxItem`, default `{ id, label, description, checked: false }`, bindable): Optional: Define the item as an object in the form {id, label, description?, checked?}
- `groupName` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Name of checkbox group
- `group` (`CheckboxItem[] | null`, default `null`, bindable): Binding for checked state of input
- `variant` (`"default" | "ghost"`, default `"default"`): Set display mode of checkbox
- `compact` (`boolean`, default `false`): Compact mode (no border)
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `onChange` (`(detail: { item: CheckboxItem; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `change` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  let checked = $state(false);
</script>

<Checkbox id="checkbox" label="Select this" bind:checked />
```

### Checkboxes

A component for defining a group of checkbox elements, whose checked values can be bound to Svelte variables, or grouped in an array.

`import { Checkboxes } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-checkboxes--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `title` (`string | null`, default `null`): Title/legend for parent <fieldset>
- `hideTitle` (`boolean`, default `false`): Visually hide the title/legend
- `label` (`string | null`, default `null`): Descriptive "how to" label for inputs
- `items` (`CheckboxItem[] | null`, default `null`): Optional: Define the checkboxes as an array of {id, label, checked, description?}
- `compact` (`boolean`, default `false`): Compact mode (no borders)
- `value` (`CheckboxItem[]`, default `[]`, bindable): Binding for selected checkboxes (if checkboxes are defined as "items")
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `onChange` (`(detail: { item: CheckboxItem; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `change` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkboxes } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  let items = [
    { id: "ice-cream", label: "Ice cream", checked: true },
    { id: "sprinkles", label: "Sprinkles", description: "Highly recommended!", checked: false },
    { id: "disabled", label: "Disabled option", checked: false, disabled: true },
  ];

  let selected = $state([]); // An array of the selected items
</script>

<Checkboxes {items} bind:value={selected} label="Select items" />
```

### Dropdown

A standard `<select>` component with Svelte bindings and events.

`import { Dropdown } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-dropdown--docs

Props:

- `id` (`string | null`, default `null`): Unique id for the <select> element
- `name` (`string | null`, default `id`): Name for the <select> element
- `label` (`string | null`, default `null`): A label to describe the <select> element (expected for accessibility)
- `hideLabel` (`boolean`, default `false`): Visually hide the label
- `description` (`string | null`, default `null`): An optional description to help users know what to enter
- `placeholder` (`string`, default `"Select an option"`): An optional placeholder text
- `value` (`object | string | null`, default `null`, bindable): A prop to bind to for the selected value
- `options` (`(object | string)[]`, default `[]`): An array of options, formatted {id, label}
- `width` (`number | string | null`, default `20`): The width of the <input> in characters or a valid css width string (eg. "100px")
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `onChange` (`(detail: { value: object | string | null; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `change` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`
- `onInput` (`(detail: { value: object | string | null; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `input` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`
- `onBlur` (`(detail: { value: object | string | null; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `blur` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Dropdown } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  const options = [
    { id: "1", label: "one" },
    { id: "2", label: "two" },
    { id: "3", label: "three" },
  ];

  // Bind the selected value to a variable (start it as null, not undefined)
  let value = $state(null);

  // Define your own function on change
  const handleChange = ({ value }) => console.log(value);
</script>

<Dropdown {options} bind:value onChange={handleChange} />
```

### ErrorPanel

Use this component to show validation errors by wrapping form inputs and fieldsets.

`import { ErrorPanel } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-errorpanel--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `message` (`string | null`, default `null`): Set an error message
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { ErrorPanel, Input } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<ErrorPanel message="You enterered the wrong text">
  <Input/>
</ErrorPanel>
```

### ErrorSummary

A panel to summarise errors on a form/input. The errors can be defined in an `items` array, or as plain text/html within the component.

`import { ErrorSummary } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-errorsummary--docs

Props:

- `title` (`string|null`, default `null`): Defines the title of the error
- `items` (`{ label: string; href?: string }[]`, default `[]`): Define an array of errors/issues in the format {label, href?}
- `cls` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `children` (`import('svelte').Snippet`): Child content

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { ErrorSummary } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  const items = [
    { label: "First issue description.", href: "#0" },
    { label: "Second issue description." },
  ];
</script>

<ErrorSummary title="There are 2 problems with your answer" {items} />
```

### Input

A standard `<input>` element with Svelte bindings and events.

`import { Input } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-input--docs

Props:

- `id` (`string | null`, default `null`): ID for <input> element
- `name` (`string | null`, default `id`): Name attribute for <input> element
- `value` (`string | null`, default `null`, bindable): A prop to bind to for the entered value
- `label` (`string | null`, default `null`): A label to describe the <input> element (expected for accessibility)
- `hideLabel` (`boolean`, default `false`): Visually hide the label
- `description` (`string | null`, default `null`): An optional description to help users know what to enter
- `placeholder` (`string | null`, default `null`): The maximum number of characters that can be entered (optional)
- `charLimit` (`number | null`, default `null`): A placeholder text for the input (optional)
- `width` (`number | string | null`, default `20`): The width of the <input> in characters or a valid css width string (eg. "100px")
- `prefix` (`string | null`, default `null`): An optional prefix (eg. £) to appear on the left of the input
- `suffix` (`string | null`, default `null`): An optional suffix (eg. %) to appear on the right of the input
- `unitLabel` (`string`, default `prefix || suffix || ""`): An optional hidden description of the prefix (for accessibility)
- `pattern` (`string | null`, default `null`): An optional regex pattern foto limit the input (not currently used)
- `numeric` (`boolean`, default `false`): Set to `true` if the value should be a number
- `readonly` (`boolean`, default `false`): Set to `true` to make the input read-only
- `disabled` (`boolean`, default `false`): Set to `true` to give the input a disabled state
- `error` (`boolean`, default `false`): Set to `true` to highlight border in red
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `onChange` (`(detail: { value: string | null; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `change` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`
- `onInput` (`(detail: { value: string | null; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `input` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`
- `onBlur` (`(detail: { value: string | null; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `blur` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
	import { Input } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

	let value = $state(null);
	const search = (query) => console.log(query);
</script>

<Input bind:value onInput={({ value }) => search(value)} />
```

### Radio

used with `Radios`; see its docs.

`import { Radio } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-radios--docs

Props:

- `id` (`string | null`, default `null`): Unique ID input
- `label` (`string | null`, default `""`): Label for input
- `description` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Extended description for element
- `item` (`RadioItem`, default `createItem(id ?? "", label ?? "", description ?? "")`): Optional: Define the item as an object in the form {id, label, description?}
- `groupId` (`string`, required): ID/name for radio group (required)
- `value` (`RadioItem | null`, default `null`, bindable): Binding selected option
- `compact` (`boolean`, default `false`): Compact mode (no border)
- `onChange` (`(detail: { value: RadioItem; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `change` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

### Radios

A component for defining a group of radio inputs, where the selected item id can be bound to a Svelte variable.

`import { Radios } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-radios--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `title` (`string | null`, default `null`): Title/legend for parent <fieldset>
- `hideTitle` (`boolean`, default `false`): Visually hide the title/legend
- `id` (`string`, default `"radios"`): Unique ID/name for radio group (required)
- `label` (`string | null`, default `null`): Descriptive "how to" label for inputs
- `value` (`RadioItem | null`, default `null`, bindable): Binding for ID of selected option
- `items` (`RadioItem[]`, default `[]`): Optional: Define the radios as an array of {id, label, description?}
- `compact` (`boolean`, default `false`): Compact mode (no border)
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `onChange` (`(detail: { value: RadioItem; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `change` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Radios } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  let items = [
    {
      id: "house",
      label: "House or bungalow",
      description: "Includes terraced, semi-detached and detached homes.",
    },
    { id: "flat", label: "Flat, maisonette or apartment" },
    { id: "mobile", label: "Caravan or other mobile or temporary structure" },
  ];

  let selected = $state(null); // A binding for the selected item
</script>

<Radios {items} bind:value={selected} label="Select one" />
```

### Select

also exported as `AccessibleSelect`. An extended alternative to an HTML `<select>` component (see Dropdown), with auto-complete and the ability to have a custom **loadOptions** function.

`import { Select } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-select--docs

Props:

- `id` (`string`, default `"autocomplete"`): Unique id for the HTML element
- `name` (`string`, default `id`): Name for the HTML element
- `mode` (`"default" | "search"`, default `"default"`): The mode can be either "default" or "search"
- `clearable` (`boolean`, default `mode !== "search"`): Defines whether the selection can be cleared
- `autoClear` (`boolean`, default `mode === "search"`): Clear value on selection (default for "search" mode)
- `autoFocus` (`boolean`, default `false`): Auto focus the search input when it is created
- `label` (`string | null`, default `mode === "search" ? "Type to select" : "Select an option"`): A label to describe the element (expected for accessibility)
- `hideLabel` (`boolean`, default `false`): Visually hide the label
- `description` (`string | null`, default `null`): An optional description to help users know what to enter
- `placeholder` (`string`, default `mode === "search" ? "Enter text" : "Select one"`): An optional placeholder text
- `value` (`object | string | null`, default `null`, bindable): A prop to bind to for the selected value
- `options` (`object[]`, default `[]`): An array of options, formatted {id, label}
- `labelKey` (`string`, default `"label"`): The attribute of an option that defines its label/name
- `groupKey` (`string | null`, default `null`): The attribute of an option that defines its group (optional)
- `renderFallback` (`boolean`, default `false`): When using SSR or pre-rendering, this option will render a text input or dropdown before the page is hydrated (allows for progressive enhancement).
- `minLength` (`number`, default `mode === "search" ? 1 : 0`): Optional: Minimum query length to return results
- `loadOptions` (`(query: string, populateResults: (results: object[]) => void) => void`, default `(query, populateResults) => { if (mode !== "search" && (!query || options.map((opt) => opt?.[labelKey]).includes(query))) populateResults(options); else { const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${query.replace(/[^\w\s]/gi, "")}`, "i"); const filteredResults = options.filter((opt) => regex.test(opt?.[labelKey])); populateResults(filteredResults); } }`): Optional: Override function for loading/filtering options based on the entered text
- `clearInput` (`() => void`, default `clearSelection`, bindable): Call this function externally to clear the input
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `onChange` (`(value: object | string) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `change` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`
- `onClear` (`(value: null) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `clear` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { AccessibleSelect } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  const options = [
    { id: "1", label: "one" },
    { id: "2", label: "two" },
    { id: "3", label: "three" },
  ];

  // Bind the selected value to a variable (start it as null, not undefined)
  let value = $state(null);

  // Define your own function on change
  const handleChange = (value) => console.log(value);
</script>

<AccessibleSelect {options} bind:value onChange={handleChange} />
```

### Textarea

A standard `<textarea>` element with Svelte bindings and events.

`import { Textarea } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-textarea--docs

Props:

- `id` (`string | null`, default `null`): ID for <textarea> element
- `name` (`string | null`, default `id`): Name for <textarea> element
- `value` (`string | null`, default `null`, bindable): A prop to bind to for the entered value
- `label` (`string | null`, default `"Enter some text"`): A label to describe the <textarea> element (expected for accessibility)
- `hideLabel` (`boolean`, default `false`): Visually hide the label
- `description` (`string | null`, default `null`): An optional description to help users know what to enter
- `charLimit` (`number | null`, default `null`): The maximum number of characters that can be entered (optional)
- `rows` (`number`, default `8`): The height of the <textarea> element in rows
- `width` (`number`, default `30`): The width of the <textarea> element in characters
- `readonly` (`boolean`, default `false`): Set to `true` to make the input read-only
- `disabled` (`boolean`, default `false`): Set to `true` to give the input a disabled state
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `onChange` (`(detail: { value: string | null; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `change` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`
- `onInput` (`(detail: { value: string | null; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `input` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`
- `onBlur` (`(detail: { value: string | null; e: Event }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `blur` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Textarea } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  // Bind the <textarea> value to a variable (start it as null, not undefined)
  let value = $state(null);

  // Define your own function on change
  const handleChange = ({ value }) => console.log(value);
</script>

<Textarea bind:value onChange={handleChange} />
```

### HelpModal

used with `Toolbar`; see its docs. Experimental.

`import { HelpModal } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-toolbar--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `triggerElement` (`HTMLElement | null`, default `null`): The element the modal is positioned next to
- `onClose` (`() => void`, default `() => {}`): Called when the modal is closed with the Escape key

### ToolbarIcon

used with `Toolbar`; see its docs. Experimental.

`import { ToolbarIcon } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-toolbar--docs

Props:

- `type` (`"move" | "polygon" | "radius" | "erase" | "zoomin" | "zoomout" | "undo" | "redo" | "search" | "save" | "download" | "upload" | "help" | "bin"`, default `"move"`): Type of icon, eg. "move", "polygon", "zoomin", "undo"
- `marginLeft` (`boolean`, default `false`): Add a small margin on the left of the icon
- `marginRight` (`boolean`, default `false`): Add a small margin on the right of the icon
- `selected` (`boolean`, default `false`): Show the icon in its selected style
- `disabled` (`boolean`, default `false`): Show the icon as disabled (greyed out)

### Toolbar

A toolbar component. Use `ToolbarsContainer` even if using one toolbar as it contains a store for all the IDs and the activeID. Experimental.

`import { Toolbar } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-toolbar--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `controls` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Toolbar controls
- `classes` (`string | null`, default `null`): Additional CSS classes for the toolbar
- `ariaLabel` (`string | null`, default `null`): aria label for button
- `orientation` (`'horizontal' | 'vertical'`, default `"horizontal"`): Orientation of the toolbar

### ToolbarButton

used with `Toolbar`; see its docs. Experimental.

`import { ToolbarButton } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-toolbar--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Content for the help modal, used when `helpText` isn't set
- `customContent` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Custom content for the button, shown when `custom` is true
- `onClick` (`(detail: null) => void`): Callback for the `click` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`
- `id` (`string`, default `slugify()`): Links the button to the ToolControl with the same `id` (generated by default)
- `icon` (`"move" | "polygon" | "radius" | "erase" | "zoomin" | "zoomout" | "undo" | "redo" | "search" | "save" | "download" | "upload" | "help" | "bin" | ""`, default `""`): Icon on button, eg. "move", "zoomin" (see ToolbarIcon for options)
- `label` (`string`, default `""`): Button label, shown in the tooltip and used as the aria label
- `disabled` (`boolean`, default `false`): Show button as disabled
- `classes` (`string`, default `""`): Additional CSS classes for the button
- `helpText` (`string | null`, default `null`): Text shown in the help modal for this button. If not set, the `children` content is used
- `selected` (`boolean`, default `false`, bindable): Whether a toggle button is selected (bindable)
- `toggle` (`boolean`, default `false`): Make the button an on/off toggle (the state is in `selected`)
- `custom` (`boolean`, default `false`): Render `customContent` instead of the standard button
- `hasAriaControls` (`boolean`, default `false`): Add `aria-controls`, pointing to the ToolControl panel with the same `id`
- `hasTooltip` (`boolean`, default `true`): Show the label in a tooltip on hover and focus
- `sticky` (`boolean`, default `false`): Keep the button's control open when the button is clicked again
- `transient` (`boolean`, default `false`): Run the click action only, without opening a control or staying selected (eg. undo)
- `disableHelp` (`boolean`, default `false`): Don't show a help modal for this button

### ButtonGroup

Radio inputs dressed up as a button group. Experimental.

`import { ButtonGroup } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/form-elements-buttongroup--docs

Props:

- `name` (`string`, default `""`): Name attribute shared by the radio inputs in the group
- `legend` (`string`, default `""`): Legend text for the group
- `value` (`string`, bindable): The selected value (bindable)
- `visuallyHideLegend` (`boolean`, default `false`): Visually hide the legend (it stays available to screen readers)

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content: the ButtonGroupItem components

```svelte
<ButtonGroup name="primary" legend="Choose an option" bind:value={selectedValue}>
...
</ButtonGroup>
```

### Accordion

An accordion component.

`import { Accordion } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-accordion--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `id` (`string`, default `slugify()`): Optional: Set the unique ID of the accordion
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `showToggle` (`boolean`, default `false`): Option to include a "show all" toggle above the accordion
- `onToggle` (`(detail: { id: string; open: boolean; el: HTMLElement }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `toggle` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Accordion, AccordionItem } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem title="First item">
    <p>Contents of first item.</p>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Second item">
    <p>Contents of second item.</p>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

### AccordionItem

used with `Accordion`; see its docs.

`import { AccordionItem } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-accordion--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `title` (`string | null`, default `null`): Sets the title of the accordion item
- `id` (`string`, default `slugify(title)`): Sets the unique ID of the accordion item
- `headingTag` (`"h2" | "h3"`, default `"h2"`): Set the heading level for the accordion items
- `open` (`boolean`, default `false`, bindable): Set the initial status of the accordion item to open (non-reactive)

### Card

Display content and links as cards. Can be used in combination with the `<Grid>` component to combine multiple cards.

`import { Card } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-card--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `imageContent` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Custom image content, used instead of the `image` prop
- `titleContent` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Custom title content, used instead of the `title` prop
- `id` (`string | null`, default `null`): Sets the unique ID of the section
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the section
- `colCls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Override default column class for the card
- `title` (`string | null`, default `null`): Sets the title of the card
- `hideTitle` (`boolean`, default `false`): Allows the h2 title tag for the card to be visually hidden
- `headingTag` (`"h2" | "h3"`, default `"h2"`): Set the heading level for the card titles
- `mode` (`"default" | "featured"`, default `"default"`): Setting mode to "featured" creates an inset card on a grey background
- `baseline` (`boolean`, default `false`): Include a border at the bottom of the card
- `href` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: URL for title/image link
- `image` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: URL for image
- `imageAlt` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Alt text for image
- `colspan` (`number`, default `1`): (If used in grid) How many columns the card should span across

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Grid, Card } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Grid>
  <Card title="Card one">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.</Card>
  <Card title="Card two">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.</Card>
  <Card title="Card three">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.</Card>
</Grid>
```

### Grid

also exported as `Cards`. A media grid component, useful for images and small multiple charts. Setting `colwidth` to **full** allows for a single cell/image/chart with an optional caption.

`import { Grid } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-grid--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `id` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Sets the unique ID of the section
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `width` (`"narrow" | "medium" | "wide" | "wider" | "full"`, default `"wide"`): Sets the width of the section
- `title` (`string | null`, default `null`): Sets the title of the section
- `hideTitle` (`boolean`, default `false`): Allows the h2 title tag for the section to be visually hidden
- `caption` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Caption for the grid (if used as a media container, eg. for an image)
- `marginTop` (`boolean`, default `false`): Adds margin above section
- `marginBottom` (`boolean`, default `true`): Adds margin below section
- `colWidth` (`"narrow" | "medium" | "wide" | "full"`, default `"medium"`): Sets the width of the columns
- `rowHeight` (`number | string | null`, default `null`): Set the minimum height of a grid row (can be a number in pixels, or a valid CSS height)
- `rowStretch` (`boolean`, default `true`): Stretch the height of grid cells to match their siblings
- `gridGap` (`"narrow" | "medium" | "wide" | "none"`, default `"medium"`): Set the grid gap, in pixels

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Grid, GridCell } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Grid>
  <GridCell>{grid_cell_content}</GridCell>
  <GridCell>{grid_cell_content}</GridCell>
  <GridCell>{grid_cell_content}</GridCell>
</Grid>
```

### Header

A header component with compact mode and theming options.

`import { Header } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-header--docs

Props:

- `title` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional product title
- `titleHref` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional link for product title
- `width` (`"narrow"|"medium"|"wide"|"wider"|"full"`, default `"wide"`): Sets the width of the header (does not apply to legacy mode)
- `theme` (`"light"|"dark"|"paleblue"|"blue"|"navyblue"|"grey"|null`, default `null`): Sets a predefined theme
- `themeOverrides` (`object`, default `{}`): Define additional props to override the base theme
- `cls` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the container
- `compact` (`boolean`, default `false`): Display compact header without menus
- `search` (`boolean`, default `true`): Include site search
- `bilingual` (`boolean`, default `true`): Set to true to include an English/Welsh language link
- `headerBorder` (`boolean`, default `false`): Include a border/line under the header. For use if hero is transparent
- `menuBorder` (`boolean`, default `false`): Include a border/line under the menu when open. For use if hero colour matches menu
- `legacy` (`boolean`, default `false`): Use the legacy nav header
- `page` (`any`, default `getContext("page")`): Optional: Pass the "page" state from "$app/state" in SvelteKit (gets read from context by default if it exists)
- `skipHref` (`string|null`, default `"#main"`): Anchor link to skip to main body content (default "#main")
- `navLinks` (`{label: string, href: string}[]|null`, default `null`): Optional: Nav links below title (only works in combination with title block). An array of links in the format {label, href}
- `before` (`import('svelte').Snippet`): Content rendered before the main content
- `after` (`import('svelte').Snippet`): Content rendered after the main content

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Header } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Header />
<!-- page body -->
```

### Hero

also exported as `Titleblock`. A hero/title block suitable for a standard pages, with optional metadata block.

- `lede` (`string|null`, default `null`): Descriptive text for page to sit below title
- `titleBadge` (`{ label: string; color?: string; ariaLabel?: string } | null`, default `null`): Optional: Badge to appear next to the page title in format {label, color}
- `actionButton` (`{ label: string; href: string; ariaLabel?: string } | null`, default `null`): Optional: Label and href for an action button in format {label, ariaLabel, href}
- `natStatBadge` (`boolean`, default `false`): Include "national statistic" badge
- `censusLogo` (`boolean`, default `false`): Include Census logo
- `meta` (`{ key: string; value: unknown }[] | null`, default `null`): Array of {key, value} objects containing page metadata
- `width` (`"narrow"|"medium"|"wide"|"wider"|"full"`, default `"wide"`): Sets the width of the container
- `height` (`number|string|null`, default `null`): Sets the (minimum) height of the container
- `cls` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `theme` (`"light"|"dark"|"blue"|"paleblue"|"navyblue"|"grey"|null`, default `null`): Sets a predefined theme
- `themeOverrides` (`Record<string, string>`, default `{}`): Define additional props to override the base theme
- `background` (`string|null`, default `null`): Overrides the background CSS for the section
- `before` (`import('svelte').Snippet`): Content rendered before the main content
- `children` (`import('svelte').Snippet`): Child content
- `after` (`import('svelte').Snippet`): Content rendered after the main content

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Hero } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
```

### NavSection

used with `NavSections`; see its docs.

`import { NavSection } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-navsections--docs

- `hideTitle` (`boolean`, default `false`): Allows the h2 title tag for the section to be visually hidden
