### NavSections

Use this component to allow users to quickly jump to named sections within a long page of content.

`import { NavSections } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-navsections--docs

Props:

- `before` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Content rendered before the main content
- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `after` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Content rendered after the main content
- `beforeNav` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Content rendered above the contents navigation
- `afterNav` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Content rendered below the contents navigation
- `footer` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Content rendered below the sections and navigation
- `id` (`string`, default `"toc"`): ID for back-linking to table of contents
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the section
- `width` (`"narrow" | "medium" | "wide" | "wider" | "full"`, default `"wide"`): Sets the width of the container
- `contentsLabel` (`string`, default `"Contents"`): A label for the page contents nav
- `noContents` (`boolean`, default `false`): Don't include table of contents (allows for custom uses of nav panel)
- `marginTop` (`boolean`, default `false`): Adds margin above section
- `marginBottom` (`boolean`, default `true`): Adds margin below section

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { NavSections, NavSection } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<NavSections>
  <NavSection title="Section one">
    <p>Contents of first section.</p>
  </NavSection>
  <NavSection title="Subsection A" subsection>
    <p>Contents of subsection.</p>
  </NavSection>
  <NavSection title="Subsection B" subsection>
    <p>Contents of subsection.</p>
  </NavSection>
  <NavSection title="Section two">
    <p>Contents of third section.</p>
  </NavSection>
</NavSections>
```

### PhaseBanner

Display a phase banner on prototypes, alpha and beta products.

`import { PhaseBanner } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-phasebanner--docs

Props:

- `phase` (`string`, default `"Beta"`): Phase of project (alpha, beta, prototype etc.)
- `description` (`string`, default `phase === "Prototype" ? "This is a prototype." : "This is a new service."`): Message to describe the phase
- `href` (`string`, default `"https://www.ons.gov.uk/feedback"`): URL of feedback form (relative or absolute)
- `width` (`"narrow"|"medium"|"wide"|"wider"|"full"`, default `"wide"`): Sets the width of the banner
- `cls` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { PhaseBanner } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<PhaseBanner />
<!-- page header -->
<!-- page contents -->
```

### Scroller

Components for adding interactive scrollytelling sections to a feature article.

`import { Scroller } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-scroller--docs

Props:

- `id` (`string | null`, default `null`): Sets the unique ID of the scroller
- `splitscreen` (`boolean`, default `false`): Enables splitscreen view (captions appear on left on larger screens)
- `marginTop` (`boolean`, default `false`): Adds a margin under the scroller section
- `marginBottom` (`boolean`, default `true`): Adds a margin under the scroller section
- `threshold` (`number`, default `0.7`): Set the threshold for the transition between scroller sections (0-1)
- `count` (`number`, default `0`, bindable): Binding: Total number of sections within scroller
- `index` (`number|null`, default `null`, bindable): Binding: Current section index (number)
- `sectionId` (`string|null`, default `null`, bindable): Binding: Current section id, if it has one set - ID for current section within scroller
- `offset` (`number`, default `0`, bindable): Binding: The progress between the start of current scroller section and next (0-1)
- `progress` (`number`, default `0`, bindable): Binding: The progress through the whole scroller (0-1)
- `visible` (`boolean`, default `false`, bindable): Binding: Whether the scroller is visible on screen or not
- `cls` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `background` (`import('svelte').Snippet`): Content for the fixed background layer
- `foreground` (`import('svelte').Snippet`): Content for the scrolling foreground layer (eg. ScrollerSection components)
- `onChange` (`(detail: ScrollDetail) => void`): Callback for the `change` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`
- `onEnter` (`(detail: ScrollDetail) => void`): Callback for the `enter` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`
- `onExit` (`(detail: ScrollDetail) => void`): Callback for the `exit` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Scroller, ScrollerSection, Container } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  function updateScroller(detail) {
    // Function to update scroller background components, using the following props:
    // 1. detail.id - the ID of the Scroller
    // 2. detail.index - the index of the current ScrollerSection
    // 3. detail.sectionId - the (optional) ID of the current ScrollerSection
  }
</script>

<Scroller onChange={updateScroller} id={any_unique_id}>
  {#snippet background()}
    <!--
      The <Container> component is optional here.
      It is a useful way to set the height and width of the background.
    -->
    <Container width="full" height="full">
      {background_components}
    </Container>
  {/snippet}
  {#snippet foreground()}
    <ScrollerSection id={any_unique_id}>
      <p>First section caption.</p>
    </ScrollerSection>
    <ScrollerSection id={any_unique_id}>
      <p>Second section caption.</p>
    </ScrollerSection>
    <ScrollerSection id={any_unique_id}>
      <p>Third section caption.</p>
    </ScrollerSection>
  {/snippet}
</Scroller>
```

### ScrollerSection

used with `Scroller`; see its docs.

`import { ScrollerSection } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-scroller--docs

Props:

- `id` (`string|null`, default `null`): Sets the unique ID of the section (identifiable in associated scroll events)
- `title` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Sets the title of the section
- `hideTitle` (`boolean`, default `false`): Allows the h2 title tag for the section to be visually hidden
- `cls` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `children` (`import('svelte').Snippet`): Child content

### Section

A layout block for text content, including an optional title.

`import { Section } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-section--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `id` (`string | null`, default `null`): Sets the unique ID of the section
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the section
- `width` (`"narrow" | "medium" | "wide" | "wider" | "full"`, default `"narrow"`): Sets the width of the container
- `height` (`number | string | null`, default `null`): Sets the (minimum) height of the container
- `title` (`string | null`, default `null`): Sets the title of the section
- `hideTitle` (`boolean`, default `false`): Allows the h2 title tag for the section to be visually hidden
- `marginTop` (`boolean`, default `false`): Adds margin above section
- `marginBottom` (`boolean`, default `true`): Adds margin below section

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Section } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Section width={narrow|medium|wide|full} title="Section title">
  <p>Contents of section.</p>
</Section>
```

### Tabs

Use tabs to help users navigate between short sections of related content within a single page, showing one section at a time.

`import { Tabs } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-tabs--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `compact` (`boolean`, default `false`): Make tabs smaller/more compact
- `border` (`boolean`, default `false`): Include a border around the tab panel
- `selected` (`string | null`, default `null`, bindable): The ID of selected tab (for binding)
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component
- `onChange` (`(detail: { id: string }) => void`, default `() => {}`): Callback for the `change` event, called with the same value as the event's `detail`

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, Tabs } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Tab one">Contents of tab panel one.</Tab>
  <Tab title="Tab two">Contents of tab panel two.</Tab>
  <Tab title="Tab three">Contents of tab panel three.</Tab>
</Tabs>
```

### Tab

used with `Tabs`; see its docs.

`import { Tab } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/layout-tabs--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `title` (`string`, default `"Tab title"`): Title of tab/panel
- `hideTitle` (`boolean`, default `true`): Hide the title within the panel
- `id` (`string`, default `slugify(title)`): ID/slug for tab (auto-generated from title if not set)

### AnalyticsBanner

This component will display a cookie banner and export a function that allows you to push events to the Google Analytics dataLayer array.

`import { AnalyticsBanner } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-analyticsbanner--docs

Props:

- `analyticsId` (`string`, default `"GTM-MBCBVQS"`): Google analytics/tags manager ID
- `analyticsProps` (`object`, default `{}`): Optional props to describe the content
- `page` (`any`, default `getContext("page")`): Optional: Pass the "page" store from "$app/state" in SvelteKit (gets read from context by default if it exists)
- `hideBanner` (`boolean`, default `false`): Use this to hide the banner (only initialises analytics if cookies already accepted)
- `usageCookies` (`boolean`, default `false`, bindable): Bind to this value if you need to know if cookies have been accepted
- `width` (`"narrow"|"medium"|"wide"|"wider"|"full"`, default `"wide"`): Set the width of the banner
- `pageViewEnabled` (`boolean`, default `true`): Enable automatic pageView event on route changes

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { AnalyticsBanner, analyticsEvent } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  // Example of an analytics event triggered by another event "e"
  function doAnalyticsEvent(e) {
    // Assumes that e.detail is in the form {key1: "value1", key2: "value2", etc}
    analyticsEvent({event: "eventName", ...e.detail});
  }
</script>

<AnalyticsBanner analyticsId={id_string} />
<!-- Rest of page content -->
```

### analyticsEvent()

`analyticsEvent()`: function exported alongside AnalyticsBanner.

### AnnouncementBanner

This banner is used to highlight important messages for all users of a service or website. The banner is only meant for critical short-term messages, and should be placed immediately below the website navigation header (and above the breadcrumb).

`import { AnnouncementBanner } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-announcementbanner--docs

Props:

- `cls` (`string|null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the section
- `title` (`string`, required): Sets the title of the banner (required)
- `description` (`string`, required): Sets the text content of the banner (required)
- `variant` (`"black"|"red"|"teal"`, default `"teal"`): Sets the variant/colour of the banner
- `linkHref` (`string|null`, default `null`): Sets the text content of the banner
- `linkText` (`string|null`, default `null`): Sets the text content of the banner
- `marginTop` (`boolean`, default `false`): Adds margin above section
- `marginBottom` (`boolean`, default `false`): Adds margin below section

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { AnnouncementBanner } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<AnnouncementBanner
  title="Important service announcement"
  description="This is a website-wide service announcement"
  linkHref="https://example.com"
  linkText="More information"/>
```

Props:

- `title` (`string|null`, default `null`): Sets the title of the list (for screen readers)
- `items` (`{ key: string; value: unknown }[]`, default `[]`): Array of items in format {key, value} where "value" may be an array of multiple values
- `mode` (`"default"|"inline"`, default `"default"`): Option to change layout to "inline", eg. for title blocks

```svelte
  ];

<DescriptionList {items}/>
```

### DocumentList

A component for defining a list of pages or links. Items can either be defined in an array of objects or as individual `<Document>` components.

`import { DocumentList } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-documentlist--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `items` (`{ title?: string | null; href?: string | null; description?: string | null; image?: string | boolean; featured?: boolean; meta?: string | null; headingTag?: "h2" | "h3" }[] | null`, default `null`): Optional: Define the documents as an array of {id, title, checked, description?}
- `compact` (`boolean`, default `false`): Compact mode. Removes horizonatal lines between documents
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { DocumentList } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  const items = [
		{
			title: "Including everyone in Census",
			href: "#0",
			meta: "Poster, PDF, 499KB, 1 page",
			description: "Empty belly poster, aimed at advertising census events."
		},
		{
			title: "Community handbook for Census 2021",
			href: "#0",
			meta: "Booklet,PDF, 3.3MB, 16 pages",
			description:
				"This handbook explains what the census is, why it matters to everyone and how we can work together to spread the word within your community."
		}
	];
</script>

<DocumentList {items} />
```

### Document

used with `DocumentList`; see its docs.

`import { Document } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-documentlist--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `title` (`string | null`, default `null`): The title of the document
- `headingTag` (`"h2" | "h3"`, default `"h2"`): Set the heading level for the title
- `href` (`string | null`, default `null`): The URL of the document
- `description` (`string | null`, default `null`): A description of the document
- `image` (`string | boolean`, default `false`): Optional: URL of image to represent the document (use "true" for a placeholder)
- `featured` (`boolean`, default `false`): Highlight document as a featured item (inset on grey background)
- `meta` (`string | null`, default `null`): Metadata about the type of document linked to (can include HTML)

### ErrorPage

An error page component that will display generic error messages for "page not found" (404) or other errors.

`import { ErrorPage } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/information-and-media-errorpage--docs

Props:

- `width` (`"narrow"|"medium"|"wide"|"wider"|"full"`, default `"narrow"`): Sets the width of the container
- `page` (`any`, default `getContext("page")`): Optional: Pass the "page" store from "$app/state" in SvelteKit (gets read from context by default if it exists)
- `status` (`number|null`): Optional: Explicitly pass a page status number, eg. 404 or 500.
- `message` (`string|null`): Optional: Explicitly pass a page status message.

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { page } from "$app/stores";
  import { ErrorPage } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<ErrorPage page={page} />
```

### ChangeStat

Shows a short directional stat such as `7% lower`, `1.3pp higher`, or `69 (0.7%) fewer`.

`import { ChangeStat } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/data-visualisation-changestat--docs

Props:

- `value` (`string | number | null`, default `null`): Highlighted change value, for example "7%" or "1.3pp"
- `direction` (`"up" | "down" | "neutral"`, default `"neutral"`): Direction of change
- `label` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional override for the descriptive label
- `context` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional trailing context, for example "than last year"
- `tone` (`"default" | "positive" | "negative" | "subtle"`, default `"default"`): Optional colour treatment
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChangeStat } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<ChangeStat value="7%" direction="down" />
<ChangeStat value="1.3pp" direction="up" />
<ChangeStat value="69 (0.7%)" label="fewer" direction="down" tone="positive" />
```

### DataCard

A component for presenting key facts and figures as a grid of "cards". Experimental.

- `caption` (`string | null`, default `null`): Text caption describing the number
- `data` (`Record<string, number>[] | null`, default `null`): An array of data (required for charts)
- `source` (`string | null`, default `null`): Text describing the source of the data

### Table

A table component with various customisation options.

`import { Table } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/data-visualisation-table--docs

Props:

- `title` (`string | null`, default `null`): An optional title for the table
- `compact` (`boolean`, default `false`): Make the table smaller/more compact
- `sortable` (`boolean`, default `false`): Make the table sortable
- `responsive` (`boolean`, default `false`): Make the chart responsive (changes layout on narrow screens)
- `rowHover` (`boolean`, default `false`): Highlight rows on hover
- `height` (`number | "auto"`, default `"auto"`): Maximum height of table (in pixels). The header row becomes sticky unless the value is "auto" (default).
- `data` (`Row[]`, default `[]`): Rows of data
- `columns` (`Column[]`): Optional metadata for formatting columns. Array of {key, label, numeric?, dp?, formatter?} objects
- `cls` (`string | null`, default `null`): Optional: Set an additional CSS class for the component

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Table } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";

  const data = [
    { col1: "Item one", col2: 10 },
    { col1: "Item two", col2: 20 },
    { col1: "Item three", col2: 30 },
  ];
  const columns = [
    { key: "col1", label: "Text column" },
    { key: "col2", label: "Numeric column", numeric: true},
  ];
</script>

<Table {data} {columns} />
```

### Em

A component to visually highlight text. Can be used for inline text or to provide a "badge".

`import { Em } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/decorators-em--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `color` (`string`, default `"lightgrey"`): Any valid CSS colour
- `mode` (`"default" | "badge"`, default `"default"`): Any valid CSS colour (CSS variables will not be parsed)
- `fontSize` (`string | null`, default `null`): Override the font size of the surrounding text
- `nowrap` (`boolean`, default `true`): Don't break text across lines
- `ariaLabel` (`string | null`, default `null`): Descriptive text for screen readers if not self-explanatory

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Em } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Em color="steelblue">Highlighted text</Em>
```

### Icon

Make use of pre-defined icons in your projects. The icon fill is set to `currentColor`, so will render in the same colour as the surrounding text.

`import { Icon } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/decorators-icon--docs

Props:

- `type` (`"arrow" | "carret" | "chevron" | "code" | "cog" | "copy" | "cross" | "delete" | "download" | "edit" | "edit-text" | "expand" | "external" | "minus" | "pin" | "plus" | "print" | "save" | "saveas" | "search" | "shrink" | "signout" | "tick" | "upload"`, default `"arrow"`): Set the type of icon
- `size` (`"s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl" | null`, default `null`): Set the size of the icon
- `rotation` (`number`, default `0`): Rotation in degrees (clockwise)
- `svgPath` (`string | null`, default `null`): (Optional) Provide a custom SVG path string for the icon (overrides "type")
- `svgViewBox` (`string`, default `"0 0 24 24"`): (Optional) If using a custom SVG path, specify the viewBox of the SVG
- `marginLeft` (`boolean`, default `false`): Add a small margin on the left of the icon
- `marginRight` (`boolean`, default `false`): Add a small margin on the right of the icon

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Icon } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Icon type="arrow" size="3xl"/>
```

### Indent

An indented block of text.

`import { Indent } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/decorators-indent--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import('svelte').Snippet`): Child content

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Indent } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Indent>{indented_text}</Indent>
```

### Tooltip

A component that displays a tooltip when the element it is wrapped around is hovered over or focused on.

`import { Tooltip } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";` · Docs: https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/?path=/docs/decorators-tooltip--docs

Props:

- `children` (`import("svelte").Snippet`): Child content
- `text` (`string`, default `""`): Define the text to be displayed on the tooltip
- `position` (`"top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right"`, default `"bottom"`): Define the position of the tooltip relative to the element
- `width` (`number | null`, default `null`): Set a maximum width for the tooltip (beyond this width text will wrap)
- `zIndex` (`number | null`, default `null`): Set z-index of tooltip, to ensure it appears in front of other elements

Example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "@onsvisual/svelte-components";
</script>

<Tooltip text="Tooltip text">
  <!-- Child element -->
</Tooltip>
```
